sections.h2: Where the office is and what it keeps
sections.html:
The Jackson County Register works from Room 108 at 401 Grindstaff Cove Road in Sylva, NC 28779. Walk-in recording and e-recording share one weekday window, opening at 8 in the morning and closing at half past four. Recording questions go to 828-586-7530.

The archives cover real estate transactions, Jackson County births and deaths, and marriage licenses issued locally. The office also records DD214 military discharge forms and issues certified copies to the discharged service member free of charge.

  • Records portal: deeds.jacksonnc.org
  • E-recording: the department page links an e-recording guide
  • Plat questions: Land Records and Mapping at 828-586-7539, or the Planning Department at 828-631-2261

Tax Administration shares the 401 Grindstaff Cove Road address, so one visit can cover both recording and the tax certification described below.

Anything filed after July 1, 2002 has to satisfy G.S. 161-14(b). A document that misses the rules draws a $25 non-standard fee on top of the usual recording charge.

  • Letter paper (8.5 by 11) or legal paper (8.5 by 14), with the original handed in
  • A three-inch blank band at the head of page one, and half an inch along its other edges and on every edge of later pages
  • Black ink on white stock, typeface of at least 10 points
  • Print on a single side
  • The name of the instrument printed beneath the top margin

Staff draft nothing, supply no forms and alter nothing on a submitted paper. If a legal description has an error, the drafter must correct it.

Land records reviews each deed too. Expect to provide an individual's or law firm's name and address as preparer on the first page, the names and addresses of the grantors and grantees, either a metes and bounds description or a plat cabinet and slide reference, the grantor's back deed references, and a statement on whether any grantor lives on the parcel as a primary residence. A deed that divides a parcel must cite a recorded survey or bear approval from the Planning Department.

Ordinary instruments run $26 for the opening fifteen pages with $4 for each page past that, and a deed of trust is $64 for its opening thirty-five pages. These amounts agree with G.S. 161-10.

A UCC termination is $38, and pages after the tenth add $2 apiece.

Payment method matters. Attorney or law firm checks, cashier's checks and money orders are taken. Personal checks are refused.

sections.h2: Deed excise tax and the tax certification
sections.html:
The county prints the tax as $2 against every $1,000 of sales price, collected when a deed that conveys an interest is filed. That matches the statute's wording of $1 on each $500.

The excise tax statute makes the seller pay the register ahead of filing. Half of the money stays with the county's general fund and half goes to the state. A parcel that straddles county lines is taxed by whichever county holds the larger value.

Jackson adds a tax check that surprises some sellers. Since March 7, 2011, every deed goes to the Tax Collector's Office for a certification that no delinquent property taxes are owed, and the collector asks for the Parcel Identification Number to speed things up. If back taxes might exist on your parcel, ask for a payoff before the day of closing so the certification does not hold up recording.

sections.h2: Property tax dates and a sale
sections.html:
Tax Administration, at the same Sylva address, bills real and personal property for the county and also collects for Dillsboro, Forest Hills, Highlands and Webster. Sylva sends its own bill and keeps its own collections.

Bills are due September 1, and January 5, 2027 is the final day to pay this cycle without interest. Starting January 6, unpaid balances pick up 2 percent, then 0.75 percent more each month. Relief program applications close June 1, and the formal appeal period for real property runs in the spring after a reappraisal notice.

Useful numbers for a seller: Tax Collections at 828-586-7550, Real Property at 828-586-7549, and Exemptions, Present-Use Value and Property Tax Relief at 828-586-7542. The county's land borders the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians, so a parcel missing from county records may sit on tribal land, which the tribe maps through its own viewer. A tax lien reaches a parcel as of the listing date under G.S. 105-355, so ask the collector to confirm any open balance in writing.

A plat sheet is accepted at 18 by 24 inches or 24 by 36 inches, with a border of at least half an inch on every side. Staff look for the surveyor's original seal and wet-ink signature plus the statements G.S. 47-30 requires.

Plats sent electronically face the same requirements as those carried in, and whoever submits is responsible for collecting signatures first. Plats filed in the office must be reproducible, black on white paper or Mylar.

Some plats go to Land Records or the Planning Department for review before they are filed. If your lot came from a recent split, ask the surveyor whether the plat is already on file, since the deed has to cite it. The charge is $21 per page.

The county had 45,039 residents in mid-2025, a rise of 4.4 percent since April 2020, across 491.11 square miles and 28,707 housing units. Homeowners hold 60.8 percent of occupied homes (2020-2024), and the typical owner-held house is worth $284,700. Middle monthly rent is $904, and median household income is $55,815.

Confirm which town's rate applies to your parcel, since municipal bills are handled differently in Sylva than in the other towns. Cullowhee has its own community planning council on the county meeting calendar.

sections.h2: A seller's checklist for the Sylva office
sections.html:
Start by getting the Parcel Identification Number, because the Tax Collector's Office wants it for the delinquent-tax certification. Ask Tax Collections at 828-586-7550 whether any balance is open. Have your closing attorney prepare a deed that meets the format rules, including the preparer's name on page one, a full legal description and the back deed reference.

On closing day the attorney's firm check, not a personal check, pays the recording fee and the excise tax. The deed goes to the Tax Collector's Office for certification and then to the Register for recording. If you paid off a loan, the satisfaction is recorded at no charge. A cash buyer skips the lender's deed of trust, so there is less to record, but the tax certification and the excise tax still apply.

faqs.q: Which office accepts a deed for filing?
faqs.a: The Register of Deeds in Room 108 at 401 Grindstaff Cove Road, Sylva. Walk-in and electronic recording share one weekday window that closes at 4:30 p.m.

faqs.q: What is the fee to file a deed in Jackson County?
faqs.a: Fifteen pages cost $26 and each added page costs $4, while a deed of trust starts at $64 for thirty-five pages. Paper outside the format rules adds $25.

faqs.q: Are personal checks accepted at the recording desk?
faqs.a: No. Attorney or law firm checks, cashier's checks and money orders are the accepted payment types.

faqs.q: Does a Jackson County deed need a tax clearance?
faqs.a: Yes. Each deed goes to the Tax Collector's Office to certify there are no delinquent property taxes, so bring the parcel number.

faqs.q: How is excise tax figured on a deed?
faqs.a: The county posts it as $2 per $1,000 of the sales price. The seller pays ahead of recording.
